                {
                  "lineNumber": 83619,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 86681,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# MVP Compliance Report\\n\\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\\n\\n### Product Identity\\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\\n\\n### Core Value Proposition\\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\\n\\n### Tech Stack\\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\\n- ✅ Docker Compose\\n\\n### User Roles\\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;amp; vouchers\\n\\n### MVP UI Scope\\n**PUBLIC:**\\n- ✅ &amp;#96; [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Deployment Checklist\\n\\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\\n\\n## Pre-Deployment\\n\\n### Environment Variables\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;DATABASE_URL&amp;#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;AUTH_SECRET&amp;#96; - Random 32+ character string\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&amp;#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&amp;#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_HOST&amp;#96; - Email server for magic links\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_PORT&amp;#96; - Email server port\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_USER&amp;#96; - Email server username\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&amp;#96; - Email server password\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_FROM&amp;#96; - From email address\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;RESEND_API_KEY&amp;#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&amp;#96; - Default \\\"from\\\" address for Resend\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&amp;#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&amp;#96; - Stripe w [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\nname: voucher\\ndescription: This is a new rule\\n---\\n\\n# Voucher Rules\\n\\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\\n\\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\\n\\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\\n\\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\\n\\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\\n\\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\\n\\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\\n\\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\\n\\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\\n\\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\\n\\nmarketplace\\n\\nfeed\\n\\nkommentaarid / like’id\\n\\nloyalty tiers / badges\\n\\nads\\n\\nAI\\n\\ngrowth-hackid\\n\\nextra analytics\\n\\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\\n\\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\\n\\nNext.js (App Router)\\n\\nTypeScript kõikjal\\n\\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\\n\\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\\n\\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\\n\\nnext-intl (EN default)\\n\\nEi mingeid:\\n\\nteisi frameworke\\n\\ncustom CSS süsteeme\\n\\nteisi ORM-e\\n\\nparoolipõhist auth’i\\n\\n## 3) ROLLID &amp;amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\\n\\nanon [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# MVP Compliance Report\\n\\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\\n\\n### Product Identity\\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\\n\\n### Core Value Proposition\\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\\n\\n### Tech Stack\\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\\n- ✅ Docker Compose\\n\\n### User Roles\\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;amp; vouchers\\n\\n### MVP UI Scope\\n**PUBLIC:**\\n- ✅ &amp;#96; [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 39223,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# MVP Compliance Report\\n\\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\\n\\n### Product Identity\\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\\n\\n### Core Value Proposition\\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\\n\\n### Tech Stack\\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\\n- ✅ Docker Compose\\n\\n### User Roles\\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;amp; vouchers\\n\\n### MVP UI Scope\\n**PUBLIC:**\\n- ✅ &amp;#96; [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 39485,

                  "lineNumber": 39807,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 40895,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\nname: voucher\\ndescription: This is a new rule\\n---\\n\\n# Voucher Rules\\n\\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\\n\\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\\n\\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\\n\\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\\n\\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\\n\\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\\n\\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\\n\\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\\n\\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\\n\\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\\n\\nmarketplace\\n\\nfeed\\n\\nkommentaarid / like’id\\n\\nloyalty tiers / badges\\n\\nads\\n\\nAI\\n\\ngrowth-hackid\\n\\nextra analytics\\n\\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\\n\\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\\n\\nNext.js (App Router)\\n\\nTypeScript kõikjal\\n\\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\\n\\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\\n\\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\\n\\nnext-intl (EN default)\\n\\nEi mingeid:\\n\\nteisi frameworke\\n\\ncustom CSS süsteeme\\n\\nteisi ORM-e\\n\\nparoolipõhist auth’i\\n\\n## 3) ROLLID &amp;amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\\n\\nanon [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Creates referral via &amp;#96;/api/referrals/create&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Generates share URL &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### C) Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ Redemption form on &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Creates locked credit\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### D) Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ Confirm button on &amp;#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### E) Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ &amp;#96;unlockCreditForRedemption()&amp;#96; in &amp;#96;lib/credits.ts&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &amp;#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &amp;#96;/api/credits/apply&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\\n\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ Cre [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 66716,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\nname: voucher\\ndescription: This is a new rule\\n---\\n\\n# Voucher Rules\\n\\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\\n\\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\\n\\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\\n\\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\\n\\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\\n\\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\\n\\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\\n\\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\\n\\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\\n\\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\\n\\nmarketplace\\n\\nfeed\\n\\nkommentaarid / like’id\\n\\nloyalty tiers / badges\\n\\nads\\n\\nAI\\n\\ngrowth-hackid\\n\\nextra analytics\\n\\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\\n\\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\\n\\nNext.js (App Router)\\n\\nTypeScript kõikjal\\n\\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\\n\\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\\n\\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\\n\\nnext-intl (EN default)\\n\\nEi mingeid:\\n\\nteisi frameworke\\n\\ncustom CSS süsteeme\\n\\nteisi ORM-e\\n\\nparoolipõhist auth’i\\n\\n## 3) ROLLID &amp;amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\\n\\nanon [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 71257,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Creates referral via &amp;#96;/api/referrals/create&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Generates share URL &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### C) Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ Redemption form on &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Creates locked credit\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### D) Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ Confirm button on &amp;#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### E) Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ &amp;#96;unlockCreditForRedemption()&amp;#96; in &amp;#96;lib/credits.ts&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &amp;#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &amp;#96;/api/credits/apply&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\\n\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ Cre [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 72691,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# MVP Compliance Report\\n\\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\\n\\n### Product Identity\\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\\n\\n### Core Value Proposition\\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\\n\\n### Tech Stack\\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\\n- ✅ Docker Compose\\n\\n### User Roles\\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;amp; vouchers\\n\\n### MVP UI Scope\\n**PUBLIC:**\\n- ✅ &amp;#96; [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 113108,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Vouchr — Brand Positioning\\n\\n**Product name:** Vouchr  \\n**Tagline:** Pay for results, not reach.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## One-paragraph positioning\\n\\nVouchr is merchant-owned referral infrastructure for local and regional businesses that rely on word-of-mouth. Instead of coupons, ads, or a marketplace, it lets you issue branded vouchers, turn loyal customers into a measurable, reward-based distribution channel, and pay them in your own store credit when their friends buy. You keep control of the brand and the relationship, and you only pay when a referred customer converts—not for clicks or impressions. Referral, measured and rewarded, for SMBs who want new customers and trust without losing control or budget to low-ROI ads.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 10-second spoken pitch\\n\\n&amp;gt; When a customer shares your voucher with a friend and that friend buys, the customer earns your store credit. It’s all branded, tracked, and controlled by you—and you only pay when it works.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Hom [... omitted end of long line]"

Instead of coupons, ads, or a marketplace, it lets you issue branded vouchers, turn loyal customers into a measurable, reward-based distribution channel, and pay them in your own store credit when their friends buy. You keep control of the brand and the relationship, and you only pay when a referred customer converts—not for clicks or impressions. Referral, measured and rewarded, for SMBs who want new customers and trust without losing control or budget to low-ROI ads.\","

                  "lineNumber": 45104,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Creates referral via &amp;#96;/api/referrals/create&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Generates share URL &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### C) Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ Redemption form on &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Creates locked credit\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### D) Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ Confirm button on &amp;#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### E) Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ &amp;#96;unlockCreditForRedemption()&amp;#96; in &amp;#96;lib/credits.ts&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &amp;#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &amp;#96;/api/credits/apply&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\\n\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ Cre [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 47257,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# MVP Compliance Report\\n\\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\\n\\n### Product Identity\\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\\n\\n### Core Value Proposition\\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\\n\\n### Tech Stack\\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\\n- ✅ Docker Compose\\n\\n### User Roles\\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;amp; vouchers\\n\\n### MVP UI Scope\\n**PUBLIC:**\\n- ✅ &amp;#96; [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\nname: voucher\\ndescription: This is a new rule\\n---\\n\\n# Voucher Rules\\n\\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\\n\\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\\n\\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\\n\\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\\n\\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\\n\\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\\n\\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\\n\\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\\n\\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\\n\\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\\n\\nmarketplace\\n\\nfeed\\n\\nkommentaarid / like’id\\n\\nloyalty tiers / badges\\n\\nads\\n\\nAI\\n\\ngrowth-hackid\\n\\nextra analytics\\n\\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\\n\\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\\n\\nNext.js (App Router)\\n\\nTypeScript kõikjal\\n\\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\\n\\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\\n\\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\\n\\nnext-intl (EN default)\\n\\nEi mingeid:\\n\\nteisi frameworke\\n\\ncustom CSS süsteeme\\n\\nteisi ORM-e\\n\\nparoolipõhist auth’i\\n\\n## 3) ROLLID &amp;amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\\n\\nanon [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 57481,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# V2 Backlog\\n\\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\\n\\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\\n\\n### Marketplace &amp;amp; Discovery\\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\\n- ❌ Deals feed\\n- ❌ Ad network\\n- ❌ Social platform features\\n\\n### Social Features\\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\\n\\n### Loyalty &amp;amp; Tiers\\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\\n- ❌ Points systems\\n- ❌ Gamification\\n\\n### AI Features\\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\\n- ❌ AI content generation\\n\\n### Advertising\\n- ❌ Ad placements\\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\\n\\n### Influencer Features\\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\\n- ❌ Creator monetization\\n\\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\\n\\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog it [... omitted end of long line]"

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 58154,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Creates referral via &amp;#96;/api/referrals/create&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Generates share URL &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### C) Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ Redemption form on &amp;#96;/r/[referralId]&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Creates locked credit\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### D) Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ Confirm button on &amp;#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ POST to &amp;#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### E) Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ &amp;#96;unlockCreditForRedemption()&amp;#96; in &amp;#96;lib/credits.ts&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Called after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n### F) User applies credit in checkout demo\\n- ✅ Checkout demo at &amp;#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Apply credit endpoint: &amp;#96;/api/credits/apply&amp;#96;\\n- ✅ Status: Working\\n\\n## ✅ Data Model Compliance\\n\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ Cre [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 63018,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\\n\\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \\\"done definition\\\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\\n\\n## Prerequisites\\n\\n1. Database is seeded: &amp;#96;npm run db:seed&amp;#96;\\n2. Development server is running: &amp;#96;npm run dev&amp;#96;\\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\\n\\n## Test Data\\n\\nAfter seeding, you should have:\\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &amp;#96;coffee-house&amp;#96;)\\n- **Admin user**: &amp;#96;admin@coffee-house.com&amp;#96;\\n- **Regular user**: &amp;#96;user@example.com&amp;#96;\\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\\n\\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\\n\\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\\n\\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\\n   &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\n   SELECT id, \\\"codePrefix\\\" FROM \\\"Voucher\\\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\\n   &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &amp;#96;npm run db:studio&amp;#96;\\n\\n2. **Open voucher page**:\\n   - URL: &amp;#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[vouc [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 66573,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# Deployment Checklist\\n\\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\\n\\n## Pre-Deployment\\n\\n### Environment Variables\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;DATABASE_URL&amp;#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;AUTH_SECRET&amp;#96; - Random 32+ character string\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&amp;#96; - Random 32+ character string\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&amp;#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_HOST&amp;#96; - Email server for magic links\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_PORT&amp;#96; - Email server port\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_USER&amp;#96; - Email server username\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&amp;#96; - Email server password\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;SMTP_FROM&amp;#96; - From email address\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&amp;#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&amp;#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;APPLE_CLIENT_ID&amp;#96; - Apple OAuth (optional)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET&amp;#96; - Apple OAuth (optional)\\n- [ ] &amp;#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&amp;#96; - Comma-separated admin em [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 90886,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &amp;lt;3s\\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\\n- ✅ Expiry visible\\n\\n### Data Model\\nAll required models present:\\n- ✅ Merchant\\n- ✅ MerchantMember\\n- ✅ User\\n- ✅ Voucher\\n- ✅ Referral\\n- ✅ Redemption\\n- ✅ CreditLedger\\n- ✅ CreditUsage\\n- ✅ AuditLog\\n\\nBusiness rules:\\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\\n- ✅ No self-referral\\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\\n\\n### Core Flows (All Working)\\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\\n\\n### Weekly Drops\\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\\n- ✅ Time window + stock\\n- ✅  [... omitted end of long line]"

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { createCheckoutSession, isStripeConfigured } from '@/lib/stripe';\nimport { checkPurchaseRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst purchaseSchema = z.object({\n  referrerId: z.string().optional(), // Optional referral ID if purchased via referral link\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    if (!isStripeConfigured()) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Stripe is not configured. Payment processing unavailable.' },\n        { status: 503 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n    const { referrerId } = purchaseSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true, campaign: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available for purchase' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkPurchaseRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if voucher is purchasable (has price in campaign or is free)\n    const price = voucher.campaign?.price ?? null;\n    if (price === null) {\n      // Free voucher - grant directly\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Use /api/vouchers/[id]/grant for free vouchers' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check purchase limits\n    if\n}",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 59
          }
        },
        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;         "contents": "export default async function TicketPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const ticket = await prisma.ticket.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      event: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      purchase: {\n        include: { user: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!ticket) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check if user owns the ticket or is merchant staff\n  const isOwner = ticket.purchase?.userId === session.user.id;\n  const isMerchantStaff = await prisma.merchantMember.findFirst({\n    where: {\n      merchantId: ticket.merchantId,\n      userId: session.user.id,\n      role: { in: ['merchant_admin', 'merchant_staff'] },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!isOwner &amp;&amp; !isMerchantStaff) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;Card className=\"max-w-md\"&gt;\n          &lt;CardContent className=\"pt-6\"&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-center text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n              You don&amp;apos;t have permission to view this ticket.\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/CardContent&gt;\n        &lt;/Card&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(ticket.qrToken);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson(ticket.event.merchant.brandColorsJson) as {\n    primary?: string;\n    secondary?: string;\n    background?: string;\n  } | null;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { Wallet, Ticket, Gift, TrendingUp, Users, CreditCard, Share2, Link2, BarChart3, Megaphone } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { getCreditBalance } from '@/lib/credits';\n\nexport default async function AppPage() {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({\n    where: { id: session.user.id },\n    include: {\n      merchantMembers: {\n        include: {\n          merchant: true,\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Get user stats\n  const ticketCount = await prisma.ticketPurchase.count({\n    where: {\n      userId: session.user.id,\n      status: 'paid',\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Get referral stats\n  let totalReferrals = 0;\n  let redeemedReferrals = 0;\n  try {\n    const referralStats = await prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['status'],\n      where: {\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n      },\n      _count: true,\n    });\n    totalReferrals = referralStats.reduce((sum, stat) =&gt; sum + stat._count, 0);\n    redeemedReferrals = referralStats.find(s =&gt; s.status === 'redeemed')?._count || 0;\n  } catch (error) {\n    // If groupBy fails (e.g., no referrals yet), use count instead\n    try {\n      totalReferrals = await prisma.referral.count({\n        where: { referrerUserId: session.user.id },\n      });\n      redeemedReferrals = await prisma.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          status: 'redeemed',\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // If all fails, default to 0\n      totalReferrals = 0;\n      redeemedReferrals = 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Get total credit balance across all merchants\n  let totalAvailable = 0;\n  let totalLocked = 0;\n  if (user?.merchantMembers) {\n    for (const member of user.merchantMembers)\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n    if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {\n      const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);\n      if (isSelf) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  let voucherId: string | undefined;\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const parsed = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n    voucherId = parsed.voucherId;\n    const { friendHint } = parsed;\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: parsed.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "/**\n * E2E test for core voucher flow:\n * 1. Merchant creates voucher\n * 2. User opens voucher page\n * 3. User creates referral\n * 4. Friend opens referral link\n * 5. Friend redeems voucher\n * 6. Staff confirms redemption\n * 7. Credit unlocks\n * 8. User applies credit\n */\ntest.describe('Voucher Flow', () =&gt; {\n  test('should complete full voucher redemption flow', async ({ page, context, authenticatedUser, testVoucher }) =&gt; {\n    // Step 1: Open voucher page (public, no login required)\n    const voucherId = testVoucher.id;\n    await page.goto(&#96;/v/${voucherId}&#96;);\n    \n    // Verify voucher page loads\n    await expect(page.locator('h1')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });\n    \n    // Step 2: User is authenticated via fixture, verify share button is visible\n    const shareButton = page.locator('button').filter({ hasText: /Share|Earn|Jaga/i });\n    \n    if (await shareButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 })) {\n      // Step 3: Create referral\n      await shareButton.click();\n      \n      // Wait for referral creation - should redirect to /r/[id] or show share URL\n      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n      \n      // Check if we're on referral page or if share was successful\n      const currentUrl = page.url();\n      if (currentUrl.includes('/r/')) {\n        // We're on referral page, continue\n      } else {\n        // Share might have opened native share or copied to clipboard\n        // In this case, we'd need to extract the URL from the share action\n        // For now, we'll create a referral via API to get the URL\n        const referralRes = await page.request.post('/api/referrals/create', {\n          data: { voucherId },\n        });\n        const referralData = await referralRes.json();\n        if (referralData.shareUrl) {\n          await page.goto(referralData.shareUrl);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Step 4: Open referral link as friend (new browser context, no auth)\n    const referralUrl = page.url();\n    const friendContext = await context.browser()?.newContext();\n    \n    if (friendContext) {\n      const friendPage = await friendContext.newPage();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || voucher.merchantId !== merchant.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check permissions\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      if (!session?.user?.id) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n      }\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      captureException(error, {\n        context: 'voucher_fetch',\n        merchantSlug: params.slug,\n        voucherId: params.id,\n      });\n    }\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function AdminPage() {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  if (!isPlatformAdmin(session.user.email)) {\n    redirect('/app');\n  }\n\n  const [merchantCount, userCount, voucherCount, redemptionCount, recentAuditLogs] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.merchant.count(),\n    prisma.user.count(),\n    prisma.voucher.count(),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n    prisma.auditLog.findMany({\n      take: 10,\n      include: {\n        actor: {\n          select: {\n            email: true,\n            name: true,\n          },\n        },\n        merchant: {\n          select: {\n            name: true,\n            slug: true,\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: {\n        createdAt: 'desc',\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  // Serialize dates to strings and parse payloadJson for client component\n  const serializedAuditLogs = recentAuditLogs.map((log) =&gt; ({\n    ...log,\n    createdAt: log.createdAt.toISOString(),\n    payloadJson: safeParseJson&lt;AuditLogPayload&gt;(log.payloadJson),\n  }));\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4\"&gt;\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\payment\\verify\\route.ts",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe';\n\nexport async function GET(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);\n    const sessionId = searchParams.get('session_id');\n\n    if (!sessionId) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing session_id' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Get Stripe checkout session\n    const checkoutSession = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId);\n\n    if (checkoutSession.payment_status !== 'paid') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, status: checkoutSession.payment_status });\n    }\n\n    // Verify purchase exists and belongs to user\n    const voucherPurchase = await prisma.voucherPurchase.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        stripeSessionId: sessionId,\n        userId: session.user.id,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const ticketPurchase = await prisma.ticketPurchase.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        stripeSessionId: sessionId,\n        userId: session.user.id,\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucherPurchase &amp;&amp; !ticketPurchase) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Purchase not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      status: voucherPurchase?.status || ticketPurchase?.status,\n      type: voucherPurchase ? 'voucher' : 'ticket',\n      id: voucherPurchase?.voucherId || ticketPurchase?.ticketId,\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Payment verification error:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to verify payment' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';",
            "lineNumber": 2

        "contents": "export async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers\n    // Otherwise, show only published vouchers\n    const where: {\n      merchantId: string;\n      status?: string;\n    } = { merchantId: merchant.id };\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      where.status = 'published';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        where.status = 'published';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(vouchers);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      captureException(error, { \n        context: 'voucher_fetch',\n        merchantSlug: params.slug \n      });\n    }\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "test.describe('Public Voucher Page', () =&gt; {\n  test('should load voucher page without login', async ({ page, testVoucher }) =&gt; {\n    const voucherId = testVoucher.id;\n    \n    await page.goto(&#96;/v/${voucherId}&#96;);\n    \n    // Verify page loads\n    await expect(page.locator('body')).toBeVisible();\n    \n    // Verify key elements are present\n    await expect(page.locator('h1')).toBeVisible(); // Headline\n    await expect(page.locator('span.font-mono, code')).toBeVisible(); // Voucher code\n  });\n\n  test('should display QR code', async ({ page, testVoucher }) =&gt; {\n    const voucherId = testVoucher.id;\n    \n    await page.goto(&#96;/v/${voucherId}&#96;);\n    \n    // Wait for QR code to load\n    const qrCode = page.locator('img[src*=\"data:image\"], img[alt*=\"QR\"]').first();\n    await expect(qrCode).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });\n    await expect(qrCode).toHaveAttribute('src', /data:image|qr/i);\n  });\n\n  test('should allow downloading QR code', async ({ page, testVoucher }) =&gt; {\n    const voucherId = testVoucher.id;\n    \n    await page.goto(&#96;/v/${voucherId}&#96;);\n    \n    // Find download button\n    const downloadButton = page.locator('button').filter({ \n      hasText: /Download|Download QR/i \n    });\n    \n    if (await downloadButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 })) {\n      // Set up download listener\n      const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() =&gt; null);\n      await downloadButton.click();\n      \n      const download = await downloadPromise;\n      if (download) {\n        expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toContain('voucher');\n        expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toContain('.png');\n      }\n    }\n  });\n});\n\ntest.describe('Referral Page', () =&gt; {\n  test\n\n}",

        "contents": "() =&gt; {\n\n);\n\n  test('should prevent self-referral redemption', async ({ page, authenticatedUser, testVoucher }) =&gt; {\n    // Step 1: Create referral as authenticated user\n    await page.goto(&#96;/v/${testVoucher.id}&#96;);\n    \n    const shareButton = page.locator('button').filter({ hasText: /Share|Earn/i });\n    if (await shareButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 })) {\n      await shareButton.click();\n      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n    }\n    \n    // Step 2: Try to redeem own referral\n    const referralUrl = page.url();\n    if (referralUrl.includes('/r/')) {\n      // Try to redeem\n      const orderAmountInput = page.locator('input[name=\"orderAmount\"], input[id=\"orderAmount\"]');\n      if (await orderAmountInput.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 })) {\n        await orderAmountInput.fill('100.00');\n        \n        const redeemButton = page.locator('button').filter({ \n          hasText: /Redeem|Use/i \n        }).first();\n        \n        if (await redeemButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 })) {\n          await redeemButton.click();\n          \n          // Wait for error message\n          await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n          \n          // Verify error message about self-referral\n          const errorMessage = page.locator('text=/self|own|cannot/i');\n          await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible({ timeout: 3000 });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  });\n});\n\ntest.describe('Public Voucher Page', () =&gt; {\n  test\n\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "import { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "import { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",

          {
            "text": "import { captureException } from '@/lib/error-tracking';",

          {
            "text": "import { z } from 'zod';",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "const createRedemptionSchema = z.object({",

          },

            "text": "  voucherId: z.string(),",

          {

            "text": "  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst referral = await \n\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n\n          // Update referral status\n          await prisma.referral.update({\n            where: { id: data.referralId },\n            data: { status: 'redeemed' },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      redemptionId: redemption.id,\n      requiresConfirmation: data.method === 'in_store',\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      captureException(error, {\n        context: 'redemption_creation',\n        endpoint: '/api/redemptions',\n        method: 'POST',\n      });\n    }\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst [hours, minutes] = (Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { unlockCreditForRedemption } from '@/lib/credits';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!redemption) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (redemption.confirmedAt) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption already confirmed' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Require merchant staff or admin role\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, redemption.merchantId, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    // Confirm redemption\n    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      await tx.redemption.update({\n        where: { id: params.id },\n        data: { confirmedAt: new Date(), redeemedByStaffUserId: session.user.id },\n      });\n\n      // Unlock credit if referral exists\n      if (redemption.referralId) {\n        await unlockCreditForRedemption(params.id, redemption.merchantId);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error confirming redemption:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst redeemTicketSchema = z.object({\n  qrToken: z.string().optional(), // If provided, verify by QR token\n  location: z.string().optional(), // Optional location for redemption\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { qrToken, location } = redeemTicketSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get ticket\n    const ticket = await prisma.ticket.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: {\n        event: {\n          include: { merchant: true },\n        },\n        purchase: {\n          include: { user: true },\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!ticket) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Ticket not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Verify QR token if provided\n    if (qrToken &amp;&amp; ticket.qrToken !== qrToken) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid QR code' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if ticket is sold\n    if (ticket.status !== 'sold') {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: &#96;Ticket is not valid for redemption. Current status: ${ticket.status}&#96; },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if already used\n    if (ticket.usedAt) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Ticket has already been used' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if user is merchant staff (can redeem any ticket) or ticket owner\n    const isMerchantStaff = await prisma.merchantMember.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: ticket.merchantId,\n        userId: session.user.id,\n        role: { in: ['merchant_admin', 'merchant_staff'] },\n      },\n    });\n\n    const isTicketOwner = ticket.purchase?.userId === session.user.id;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Check rate limits for redemption attempts\n */\nexport async function checkRedemptionRateLimit(\n  friendHash: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 5\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - windowMinutes * 60 * 1000);\n\n  const recentCount = await prisma.redemption.count({\n    where: {\n      referral: {\n        friendHash,\n      },\n      createdAt: {\n        gte: windowStart,\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    allowed: recentCount &lt; maxAttempts,\n    remaining: Math.max(0, maxAttempts - recentCount),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Check rate limits for voucher purchases\n */\nexport async function checkPurchaseRateLimit(\n  userId: string,\n  windowMinutes: number = 60,\n  maxAttempts: number = 20\n): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, any&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.designJson);\n  const brandColors = safeParseJson&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson);\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n      isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}\n    /&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\nimport { sendCreditUnlocked } from './emails';\n\n/**\n * Unlock credit after redemption confirmation\n */\nexport async function unlockCreditForRedemption(\n  redemptionId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n    where: { id: redemptionId },\n    include: {\n      referral: {\n        include: {\n          referrer: true,\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!redemption || !redemption.referral) {\n    throw new Error('Redemption not found or has no referral');\n  }\n\n  if (redemption.merchantId !== merchantId) {\n    throw new Error('Merchant mismatch');\n  }\n\n  // Find locked credit for this redemption\n  const lockedCredit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({\n    where: {\n      merchantId,\n      source: 'referral_redemption',\n      sourceId: redemptionId,\n      status: 'locked',\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!lockedCredit) {\n    // Credit might already be unlocked or doesn't exist\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Unlock the credit\n  await prisma.creditLedger.update({\n    where: { id: lockedCredit.id },\n    data: {\n      status: 'available',\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Send email notification\n  if (redemption.referral.referrer.email)\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n              if (referrerId &amp;&amp; campaign?.creditPercentage) {\n                const referrer = await prisma.user.findUnique({\n                  where: { id: referrerId },\n                });\n\n                if (referrer) {\n                  const creditAmount = Math.floor(\n                    (purchase.amount * (campaign.creditPercentage || 0)) / 10000\n                  ); // creditPercentage is in basis points\n\n                  if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n                    const expiresAt = new Date();\n                    expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n                    await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n                      data: {\n                        merchantId: purchase.merchantId,\n                        userId: referrerId,\n                        amount: creditAmount,\n                        currency: purchase.currency,\n                        status: 'available', // Available immediately on purchase\n                        source: 'referral_purchase',\n                        sourceId: purchase.id,\n                        expiresAt,\n                      },\n                    });\n\n                    // Send credit earned email\n                    if (referrer.email) {\n                      const balance = await getCreditBalance(referrerId, purchase.merchantId);\n                      const walletUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/app/${purchase.merchant.slug}/wallet&#96;;\n\n                      await sendCreditEarned({\n                        to: referrer.email,\n                        merchantName: purchase.merchant.name,\n                        creditAmount: (creditAmount / 100).toFixed(2),\n                        currency: purchase.currency.toUpperCase(),\n                        totalBalance: (balance.total / 100).toFixed(2),\n                        walletUrl,\n                      });\n                    }\n                  }\n                }\n              }\n\n              // Log audit\n              await\n}",
